nodes.label: Flow: Tailoring a Resume
nodes.rationale: The AI only rewords and selects; everything it writes is checked against the user's own text before it is kept.

nodes.label: Tailoring Conflict Rules
nodes.rationale: Ranking order among relevant entries; substantial work beats coursework; jobs/education always kept; confirmed skills lead within 18-skill limit; word limit beats bullet counts; hackathon+project merged once to keep ATS keywords.

nodes.label: Grounding Guarantees (entry match, number check, borrowed names)
nodes.norm_label: grounding guarantees (entry match, number check, borrowed names)

nodes.label: Grounded AI (fact-check + rule check)
nodes.rationale: AI may only use facts from the user's resume and notes; employers, titles, dates pinned, invented numbers undone, unsupported skills dropped.

nodes.label: Revision-Checked Multi-Device Saves
nodes.rationale: Fixes a device holding an old copy overwriting newer data; stale device fetches latest and re-applies only its own change.

nodes.label: Laptop Data Folder (state.json, jobs.json, board-jobs.json, geocache.json, creds.bin, meta.json)

nodes.norm_label: flow: saving from several devices (409 conflict + re-apply)

nodes.label: Release Workflow (GitHub Actions)
nodes.rationale: macOS apps can only be built on macOS, hence the OS matrix; triggered on v* tags.

nodes.label: Unsigned / Un-notarised App Install Workaround
nodes.rationale: App is not code-signed or notarised, so SmartScreen 'Run anyway' and macOS 'Open Anyway' / xattr quarantine removal are documented.

nodes.label: Paste a Link, Get the Job
nodes.norm_label: paste a link, get the job

nodes.label: Flow: LinkedIn/Indeed Search and Pasted Links
nodes.norm_label: flow: linkedin/indeed search and pasted links
nodes.rationale: Pasted links are refused for localhost/private IPs (SSRF guard); bot checks are never bypassed.

nodes.label: LinkedIn and Indeed Search
nodes.rationale: Indeed full descriptions sit behind a human-verification check, which is never bypassed, so only card summary/pay/tags are kept.

nodes.label: API-Key AI Providers (Gemini, OpenAI, Qwen, Claude, Perplexity)
nodes.norm_label: api-key ai providers (gemini, openai, qwen, claude, perplexity)

nodes.label: Printer-Accurate Page Counting
nodes.rationale: Entries never split across pages and preview zoom no longer skews measurement, so a resume shown as 2 pages prints on exactly 2.

nodes.label: Flow: Fitting a Resume onto A4 Pages
nodes.norm_label: flow: fitting a resume onto a4 pages
nodes.rationale: Paginate like the printer, shrink never below 8 pt, then tighten spacing, then fewer bullets; fill page 2 with ranked projects while still 2 pages.

nodes.label: Concurrent Per-Job Tailoring
nodes.rationale: Each job keeps its own progress so switching jobs/tabs never stops AI work; signed-in requests retry on shared sign-in refresh or brief rate limits.

nodes.label: Type 'delete' Confirmation
nodes.rationale: GitHub-style typed confirmation prevents accidental deletion of entries, sections, results or backups.

nodes.label: Flow: AI With API Key or Own Account
nodes.norm_label: flow: ai with api key or own account

nodes.label: Signed-in AI (Gemini CLI / Claude Code)
nodes.rationale: Use the user's own Google/Claude plan instead of an API key; runs in an empty temp folder; Perplexity has no official sign-in tool and chat websites are never automated.

nodes.label: AI Only On Click (token-cost confirmation)
nodes.rationale: Nothing calls the AI automatically; every ✦ action confirms provider/model and warns of token cost.
